# Supervisor setting: store field, GET/PUT /api/workspaces/:id/supervisor, and the drawer fieldset ## What to build A per-workspace **Supervisor** setting for graph-manager (`apps/graph-manager`), KAN-92 (spec `docs/prd/agent-supervisor.md`, "Requirements → Run origins and the supervisor (KAN-92) → Setting"). It says what the agent that started a run does when the run fails: `report` (default: tell the user, change nothing) or `act` (fix, commit, `resume_run`). This slice adds the setting end to end; a later slice (the run event watcher) reads it with `supervisorModeOf` and writes the mode into the failure line it types into the agent's terminal, and a `list_runs` tool prints `Supervisor: `. Layers: 1. **Store** (`src/server/store.ts`): `workspaceSettings[].supervisor: z.enum(["report", "act"]).optional()`, plus `export type SupervisorMode = "report" | "act"` and `export function supervisorModeOf(data: Data, wsId: string): SupervisorMode` (returns `"report"` when unset). 2. **Routes** (new `src/server/routes/supervisor.ts`, registered in `src/server/app.ts`): `GET /api/workspaces/:id/supervisor` → `200 { mode }`; `PUT /api/workspaces/:id/supervisor` with body `{ mode: "report" | "act" }` → `204` (no body). `404 { error: "unknown workspace" }` for an unknown workspace, `400` for any other mode / body (the app's ZodError handler does that when you `.parse`). 3. **Web** (`src/web/pages/WorkspaceSettingsDrawer.tsx`, `src/web/types.ts`): a fieldset **Supervisor** with two radios, "Report to me" (`report`) and "Fix and rerun" (`act`), and the hint "What the agent that started a run does when the run fails." The value is loaded when the drawer opens and saved by the drawer's existing **Save** button together with the other settings. 4. **Tests** for the store helper, the routes and the drawer. ## Context: files to read before implementing - `docs/prd/agent-supervisor.md` — the spec; the "Setting" bullets under "Run origins and the supervisor (KAN-92)", and the Decisions row "The Supervisor setting lives in `workspaceSettings[].supervisor`…". - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/store.ts` (lines 71–90) — `workspaceSettings` schema (`image`, `sandbox`, `recipe`), `Data` type and the exported type aliases below it. Add the field and the helper here. - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/sandbox.ts` (lines 103–163) — the existing `GET/PUT /api/workspaces/:id/settings`: how a workspace id is resolved (`resolveWorkspace(ctx.config.workspacesDir, req.params.id)`, 404 `{ error: "unknown workspace" }`), and how the PUT rewrites `d.workspaceSettings[ws.id]` with a spread (`const next = { ...d.workspaceSettings[ws.id] }`, lines 146–154). That spread keeps the new `supervisor` field; don't break it. Also `routes/runs.ts` lines 56–60 (`rememberSandbox`) and `routes/internal.ts` line 150 write the `sandbox` flag with a spread too. - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/app.ts` (lines 16–28 imports; lines 144–157 "feature routes (one line per feature)") — where to import and register `supervisorRoutes`. - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/workspaces.ts` (lines 57–70) — `resolveWorkspace(root, id)`: undefined unless `///` exists and holds `.git`. - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/test-helpers.ts` (whole file, 61 lines) — `appWithLogin()` gives `{ app, cookie, config, store, cleanup }`. - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/sandbox.test.ts` (lines 310–352, 401–445) — the closest route test: makes the workspace dir and `git init`, then `app.inject` with the cookie; checks 404 for `github~octo~nope`, 401 without login. - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/store.test.ts` — store tests; add a `supervisorModeOf` case there. - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/WorkspaceSettingsDrawer.tsx` (whole file, 319 lines) — the drawer: load effect (lines 62–98), `save` (lines 135–172), the "Sandbox image" fieldset (lines 224–239) whose radio markup you mirror. - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/types.ts` (lines 186–199) — `WorkspaceImageSource` / `WorkspaceSettings`; add `SupervisorMode` next to them. - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Workspaces.test.tsx` (lines 69–190 `FakeOpts` + `fakeApi`; lines 398–480 `describe("Workspace settings drawer")`) — the drawer tests. **`fakeApi` answers 404 for any URL it doesn't know**, so the new GET must be added there. - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/api.ts` — `api(path)` and `post(path, body, method)`; both throw `ApiError` on non-2xx. A 204 answer has an empty body: `api` returns `undefined`, which is fine. ## Patterns to follow **Store schema** (`store.ts` lines 75–84 today): ```ts workspaceSettings: z .record( z.string(), z.object({ image: z.string().optional(), sandbox: z.boolean().optional(), recipe: z.preprocess(migrateRecipe, recipeSchema).optional(), // add: what the agent that started a run does when it fails (docs/prd/agent-supervisor.md); unset = "report". supervisor: z.enum(["report", "act"]).optional(), }), ) .default({}), ``` Helper, exported from `store.ts` below the type aliases: ```ts export type SupervisorMode = "report" | "act"; /** The workspace's Supervisor setting; `report` when unset. */ export function supervisorModeOf(data: Data, wsId: string): SupervisorMode { return data.workspaceSettings[wsId]?.supervisor ?? "report"; } ``` **Route module** (mirror `routes/sandbox.ts` lines 117–121 and the `export async function xxxRoutes(app, ctx)` shape): ```ts import type { FastifyInstance } from "fastify"; import { z } from "zod"; import type { AppContext } from "../app.js"; import { supervisorModeOf } from "../store.js"; import { resolveWorkspace } from "../workspaces.js"; const body = z.object({ mode: z.enum(["report", "act"]) }).strict(); export async function supervisorRoutes(app: FastifyInstance, ctx: AppContext): Promise { app.get<{ Params: { id: string } }>("/api/workspaces/:id/supervisor", async (req, reply) => { const ws = resolveWorkspace(ctx.config.workspacesDir, req.params.id); if (!ws) return reply.code(404).send({ error: "unknown workspace" }); return { mode: supervisorModeOf(ctx.store.get(), ws.id) }; }); app.put<{ Params: { id: string } }>("/api/workspaces/:id/supervisor", async (req, reply) => { const ws = resolveWorkspace(ctx.config.workspacesDir, req.params.id); if (!ws) return reply.code(404).send({ error: "unknown workspace" }); const { mode } = body.parse(req.body ?? {}); // ZodError → 400 via app.setErrorHandler (app.ts lines 105–110) await ctx.store.update((d) => { d.workspaceSettings[ws.id] = { ...d.workspaceSettings[ws.id], supervisor: mode }; }); return reply.code(204).send(); }); } ``` Resolve the workspace **before** parsing the body so an unknown workspace is 404 even with a bad body. **Auth:** every `/api/*` route except `/api/internal/*` and the login routes needs the session cookie (the hook in `src/server/auth.ts`); nothing to add, but test the 401. **Drawer radios** (mirror lines 224–239): ```tsx
Supervisor {SUPERVISOR_MODES.map((m) => ( ))} What the agent that started a run does when the run fails.
``` with `const SUPERVISOR_MODES: { value: SupervisorMode; label: string }[] = [{ value: "report", label: "Report to me" }, { value: "act", label: "Fix and rerun" }];`. Place it after the sandbox image sections and before the `{error && …}` paragraph. **Web test pattern** (`Workspaces.test.tsx`): extend `FakeOpts` with `supervisor?: "report" | "act"` and `supervisorStatus?: number` (an error status for the PUT), keep `state.supervisor`, and add to `fetchMock` before the final 404: ```ts if (/^\/api\/workspaces\/[^/]+\/supervisor$/.test(url) && method === "GET") return json({ mode: state.supervisor }); if (/^\/api\/workspaces\/[^/]+\/supervisor$/.test(url) && method === "PUT") { if (opts.supervisorStatus) return json({ error: "mode: invalid" }, opts.supervisorStatus); state.supervisor = (JSON.parse(String(init?.body)) as { mode: "report" | "act" }).mode; return new Response(null, { status: 204 }); } ``` Use the existing `openDrawer()` helper inside `describe("Workspace settings drawer")`. ## Step-by-step tasks ### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/store.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: the `supervisor` field in the `workspaceSettings` object schema, `SupervisorMode` and `supervisorModeOf` as in the snippet. Update the JSDoc above `workspaceSettings` (lines 71–74) with one sentence about `supervisor`. - **GOTCHA**: `DataStore.update` re-parses the whole data with `dataSchema.parse` — an invalid value can never be stored. Old `graph-manager.json` files have no `supervisor`; `.optional()` keeps them valid. - **VALIDATE**: `npm run typecheck` ### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/store.test.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: a test "supervisorModeOf defaults to report and reads the stored mode": open a `DataStore` in a temp dir (`tempDir()` from `./test-helpers.js`, as the other tests in that file do), check `supervisorModeOf(store.get(), "github~octo~hello")` is `"report"`, `await store.update((d) => { d.workspaceSettings["github~octo~hello"] = { supervisor: "act" }; })`, then `"act"`; and that `store.update` with `supervisor: "nope" as never` rejects. - **VALIDATE**: `npm test -w graph-manager -- src/server/store.test.ts` ### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/supervisor.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: `supervisorRoutes` as in the snippet. - **IMPORTS**: `FastifyInstance` from `fastify`, `z` from `zod`, `AppContext` from `../app.js`, `supervisorModeOf` from `../store.js`, `resolveWorkspace` from `../workspaces.js`. Relative imports end in `.js` (ESM, NodeNext). - **VALIDATE**: `npm run typecheck` ### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/app.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: `import { supervisorRoutes } from "./routes/supervisor.js";` with the other route imports, and `await supervisorRoutes(app, ctx);` appended to the "feature routes" block (after `await agentRequestRoutes(app, ctx);`). Additive only: other parallel tasks also append lines here. - **VALIDATE**: `npm run typecheck` ### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/supervisor.test.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: with `appWithLogin()` (no Docker needed) and a workspace made like `sandbox.test.ts` `withWorkspace()` (`mkdir(path.join(c.config.workspacesDir, "github", "octo", "hello"), { recursive: true })` + `execa("git", ["init", "-q", "-b", "main"], { cwd })`). Cases: 1. `GET /api/workspaces/github~octo~hello/supervisor` → 200 `{ mode: "report" }` (unset). 2. `PUT … { mode: "act" }` → 204 with an empty body; then GET → `{ mode: "act" }`; `c.store.get().workspaceSettings["github~octo~hello"]?.supervisor` is `"act"`. PUT `{ mode: "report" }` → GET `{ mode: "report" }`. 3. PUT `{ mode: "fix" }`, PUT `{}` and PUT `{ mode: "act", extra: 1 }` → 400 each; the stored value is unchanged. 4. Unknown workspace `github~octo~nope`: GET and PUT → 404 `{ error: "unknown workspace" }`. 5. No cookie: GET and PUT → 401. 6. Regression: after PUT `{ mode: "act" }`, `PUT /api/workspaces/github~octo~hello/settings { source: "global" }` (the sandbox image settings) keeps `supervisor: "act"` — GET supervisor still answers `act`. (With no Docker, `appWithLogin()` still builds `ctx.sandboxes`; the `global` source needs no Docker call.) - **PATTERN**: `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/sandbox.test.ts:310-352` and `:435-445`. - **VALIDATE**: `npm test -w graph-manager -- src/server/routes/supervisor.test.ts` ### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/types.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: `/** \`GET/PUT /api/workspaces/:id/supervisor\` (docs/prd/agent-supervisor.md). */ export type SupervisorMode = "report" | "act";` next to `WorkspaceImageSource`. - **GOTCHA**: the web code must not import from `src/server` (separate tsconfig `tsconfig.web.json`); declare the type in `web/types.ts`. ### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/WorkspaceSettingsDrawer.tsx` - **IMPLEMENT**: - `const supervisorUrl = (id: string) => \`/api/workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/supervisor\`;` next to `settingsUrl`. - State `supervisor` and `savedSupervisor` (both `SupervisorMode`, default `"report"`); reset both to `"report"` in the load effect (lines 62–74) and load with `api<{ mode?: unknown }>(supervisorUrl(id)).then((s) => alive && (s?.mode === "act" || s?.mode === "report") && (setSupervisor(s.mode), setSavedSupervisor(s.mode)), () => undefined)`. A failed load keeps `report` silently (do not set `error`, and do not make `loaded` wait for it). - In `save()`, after the existing image validation and `setBusy(true)`, inside the existing `try`: when `supervisor !== savedSupervisor`, `await post(supervisorUrl(wsId), { mode: supervisor }, "PUT")` first, then `if (current.current !== wsId) return; setSavedSupervisor(supervisor);`, then the existing settings PUT. An error lands in the existing `catch` (shown in `workspace-settings-error`, drawer stays open). Only PUT the supervisor when it changed, so the existing tests' request expectations stay as they are. - The fieldset from the snippet, after the image sections and before the error paragraph. Update the component's JSDoc (lines 31–34) to mention the Supervisor setting. - **GOTCHA**: keep the existing `data-testid`s and texts; the existing tests in `Workspaces.test.tsx` assert them. The save path that keeps the drawer open for a queued recipe build (`if (body.source === "recipe" && queued) return;`) must still have saved the supervisor before it returns — that's why the supervisor PUT goes first. - **VALIDATE**: `npm run typecheck && npm run lint` ### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Workspaces.test.tsx` - **IMPLEMENT**: the `fakeApi` additions from the pattern, and in `describe("Workspace settings drawer")`: 1. "shows the Supervisor setting with Report to me checked by default": `within(drawer).getByTestId("workspace-supervisor").textContent` contains `Supervisor`, `Report to me`, `Fix and rerun` and `What the agent that started a run does when the run fails.`; `workspace-supervisor-report` checked, `workspace-supervisor-act` not. 2. "opens with the stored mode": `fakeApi({ …, supervisor: "act" })` → `workspace-supervisor-act` becomes checked (`await waitFor`). 3. "saves Fix and rerun with PUT { mode: act } and closes": click `workspace-supervisor-act`, click `workspace-settings-save`, drawer closes, the fetch mock got exactly one `PUT /api/workspaces/github~octo~hello/supervisor` with body `{ mode: "act" }`, and the settings PUT still happened. 4. "does not PUT the supervisor when it did not change": open, Save → no PUT to the supervisor URL. 5. "shows a failed supervisor save in the drawer": `supervisorStatus: 400` → `workspace-settings-error` shows `mode: invalid`, drawer stays open. - **VALIDATE**: `npm test -w graph-manager -- src/web/pages/Workspaces.test.tsx` ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] `workspaceSettings[*].supervisor` is `z.enum(["report", "act"]).optional()`; `supervisorModeOf(data, wsId)` returns `"report"` when unset, the stored mode otherwise; `SupervisorMode` is exported from `store.ts`. - [ ] `GET /api/workspaces/:id/supervisor` → `200 { "mode": "report" | "act" }`; unset → `report`. - [ ] `PUT /api/workspaces/:id/supervisor { "mode": "act" }` → `204`, then GET → `{ "mode": "act" }`. - [ ] Unknown workspace → `404 { "error": "unknown workspace" }`; another mode or extra keys → `400`; no session → `401`. - [ ] Saving the sandbox image settings (`PUT /api/workspaces/:id/settings`) keeps the supervisor value. - [ ] The workspace settings drawer shows a fieldset "Supervisor" with radios "Report to me" / "Fix and rerun" and the hint "What the agent that started a run does when the run fails."; it loads the stored mode, and Save PUTs a changed mode. - [ ] Tests pass: `npm test -w graph-manager -- src/server/store.test.ts src/server/routes/supervisor.test.ts src/web/pages/Workspaces.test.tsx` ## Validation commands ```bash # from the repo root npm run typecheck && npm run lint npm test -w graph-manager -- src/server/store.test.ts src/server/routes/supervisor.test.ts src/web/pages/Workspaces.test.tsx npm test -w graph-manager ```
